I couldn't find any information about my trouble

```
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS default.message_by_chid (
...
)
ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/cluster_cross_r1/tables/{shard}/message_by_chid', '{replica}')
```
